Initial board:
#######
#.P...#
#.B...#
##....#
#..#..#
#..#G.#
#######
Initial attempts: U was blocked twice. Board unchanged.
Give one short strategic hint for this board. Point out a specific intermediate position or push direction. Do not give a full move sequence.
calls.output: To solve this, **position yourself directly below the crate (on the same column as the crate, one tile lower) first, so you can push the crate downward initially**. This moves the crate out of its starting upper-left area and lets you navigate it around the central wall gap toward the goal.
